name: touchportal-meldstudio-plugin
description: Touch Portal integration with Meld Studio

scripts.start-dist: npm run clean && tsc && node dist/index.js
scripts.build-windows-x64: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js -p Windows -a x64
scripts.build-windows-arm64: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js -p Windows -a arm64
scripts.build-linux-x64: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js -p Linux -a x64
scripts.build-linux-arm64: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js -p Linux -a arm64
scripts.build-mac-x64: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js -p MacOS -a x64
scripts.build-mac-arm64: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js -p MacOS -a arm64
scripts.full-build: npm run clean && tsc && node builders/entry.mjs && node builders/build.js

author: Jameson Allen (aka Spdermn02)
